description: List all email sequences (automations). Read effectiveStatus (draft, live, enrollment_paused, paused, archived) to know whether a sequence is running: status alone reads `active` even when new enrollments are paused, and the legacy triggerConfig.active flag is not used by the runtime.

companyId.description: Company ID to list sequences for. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

labels.description: Return sequences assigned any of these dashboard label names.

limit.description: Page size from 1 to 100. When limit and offset are both omitted, every sequence is returned.

search.description: Case-insensitive search across sequence name and description.

name: list_sequences

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_sequences` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

pagination.description: Sequence page window: `limit` (null when limit and offset were both omitted and every sequence was returned), `offset`, `count` returned in this page, `total` matching the filters, and `hasMore`.

sequences.description: List of sequence records returned by Sequenzy. Run state: branch on effectiveStatus (draft, live, enrollment_paused, paused, or archived) rather than on status, which reads `active` even when new enrollments are paused. acceptsNewEnrollments and processesExistingEnrollments answer the two questions behind it, and effectiveStatusSummary is a plain-language sentence. The legacy triggerConfig.active flag is not read by the runtime; it is reported as a mirror of acceptsNewEnrollments. emailCount is the number of email-sending steps; an A/B test step counts once.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
